decisions.decision: Use exactly 3 and 4 players. Use the illustrated beginner setup; remove red at three players. The profile designates player 0 as the oldest seat and start player. Variable setup and experienced merged phases are out of scope.

Production of a resource occurs only if the bank can satisfy every entitlement completely; bank trades, Year of Plenty and development purchases are legal only when their full effect is available; Road Building places the maximum feasible and available number up to two.
Longest Road is the maximum edge-simple trail: no road edge may be counted twice, a vertex may be revisited when the trail permits it, and opponent-occupied vertices stop traversal.

The supplied seed controls dice, development shuffle and blind theft. Robber victim eligibility is based on adjacent opponent buildings, not hand contents; choosing an empty resource hand transfers nothing, and no adjacent opponent means no theft. Seven discards are privately selected and applied together. Public observations expose resource hand sizes, face-down development counts, bank, board and visible score only; hidden victory points remain excluded.

A finite bilateral offer subphase lets the active player build positive give/take bundles for one partner one resource at a time; the partner accepts or rejects; acceptance transfers atomically and rejection/cancellation transfers nothing.
Victory detection reveals only the minimum number of hidden victory-point cards needed to establish ten, in development-hand order.

Subject to the publisher-clear one-development-card-per-turn limit, an eligible active-player development card may interrupt pending discard, seven-sourced robber, or trade-consent decisions. Resolve the new card on top of a pending-state stack, then resume the interrupted decision unless victory terminates the game. A pending Knight/progress effect already consumed the turn's card allowance and cannot be interrupted by another development card.
Check active-player victory after every completed atomic action or committed subaction; immediate victory cancels any remaining Road Building placement or other pending effect.
